venues.name: Kiva Auditorium at the Albuquerque Convention Center

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office is in the ABQ Convention Center's west building, basement level, open Mon. thru Fri. 9a. - 4p. On the day of an event, box office is open 2 hours prior to showtime on the 2nd level.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express. No Cash
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call is available at the Kiva Auditorium box office. Picture ID that matches the pick-up name is required.

venues.parkingDetail: Primary parking is available at the Convention Center Parking Garage (Martin Luther King Blvd & Broadway); with overflow parking available at the Civic Plaza garage (Marquette & 3rd St.). Additionally, there are numerous other public parking garages and parking lots available throughout downtown close to the Center. Parking fees vary. Please refer to the posted parking fees at each garage or lot. Street parking is limited.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available at the last row of the pit section. If there are no more marked accessible seating for purchase, accessible seating relocation can be accommodated upon request by calling (505) 768-4575 or coming to the box office after purchasing seats.

generalInfo.generalRule: No outside food or beverages will be allowed inside the Convention Center/Kiva Auditorium. Beverages purchased on-site will be allowed in the Kiva Auditorium. No backpacks or large purses are allowed. Small purses, fanny packs and handbags, must be no larger than 5" x 8", and will be subject to search. Clear totes no larger than 12" x 6" x 12" or one-gallon clear plastic bag are also allowed. Please Be Advised: Anyone entering the facilities is subject to Security Screening. All bags are subject to be searched upon entry into the venue. If your bag is turned away for not following the clear bag policy, you must return it to your vehicle. No smoking in the Convention Center or Kiva Auditorium. No laser pointers are allowed. No video recorders/cameras allowed. No audio recorders are allowed. Weapons are strictly prohibited.
generalInfo.childRule: EVERYONE must have a ticket, regardless of age.

events.name: Monster Jam
events.info: Get ready for the ultimate family day out! With awesome trucks, amazing stunts, big air and action-packed excitement, Monster Jam® is the definition of fun for everyone! Watch as 12,000lb trucks stand on two wheels and fly through the air. See the world's most popular trucks like Grave Digger® El Toro Loco®, Sparkle Smash and more only at Monster Jam. Be loud, cheer hard and watch these Monster Jam trucks do the impossible. It's too fun to miss!
events.pleaseNote: -All guests age 2 & older are required to have a ticket. -Note: Costumes not permitted for guests 14 years & older. -Monitor the venue website for venue policies, including health and safety protocols, which are subject to change. -All tickets are subject to availability. -Prices & Competitors are subject to change. -Monster Jam Trackside begins approximately one hour before the event start time and features: o Competition Preview o Driver Interviews o Behind the Scenes with the Pit Crew o Judges Zone Overview o Opening Ceremonies o Giveaways o Power Rush Truck Introductions There's no better way to get ready for the action, so get to your seats early to experience all the family fun. -Visit MonsterJam.com for more event info and Ticket Terms and Conditions.

events.name: Franco Escamilla- "El Juicio" Tour
events.info: ¡Prepárate para El Juicio más divertido de tu vida! Franco Escamilla regresa con todo a los escenarios para presentar su espectacular nuevo show "El Juicio". En esta ocasión, El Máximo Tribunal de la Comedia abre sus puertas y nadie se va a salvar. Franco pondrá sobre la mesa sus anécdotas más íntimas, sus secretos mejor guardados y los momentos más vergonzosos de su vida que por fin saldrán a la luz. Se presentarán pruebas contundentes y evidencias innegables de que la realidad muchas veces supera a la ficción! La gran pregunta es: entre secretos confesados y carcajadas, ¿quién se atreverá a juzgarlo? En El Juicio el único veredicto final e indiscutible es que las risas y la diversión están 100% garantizadas. El máximo Tribunal de la Comedia entra en sesión!

events.name: Alice In Wonderland by International Ballet Stars & Romero Britto

presales.name: Black Friday Sale
presales.description: Buy 4 tickets and save 25% on the 4th ticket.

events.info: The World Premiere of Alice in Wonderland, created in collaboration with acclaimed artist Romero Britto, brings Lewis Carrolls beloved story to life through a bold and wildly imaginative artistic vision. Set to Claude Debussys exquisite music, the production follows Alice down the rabbit hole into a surreal wonderland bursting with Brittos iconic color, fantasy, and energy. From the charming Mad Hatter to the delightfully parodic Queen of Hearts, familiar characters are reimagined through spectacular choreography, immersive visuals, and extraordinary theatrical design. Featuring an international cast of ballet stars from 16 countries, Alice in Wonderland brings together world-class dance, timeless music, and contemporary art in a one-of-a-kind theatrical experience for audiences of all ages. A vibrant celebration of imagination where ballet meets fearless color, this World Premiere invites audiences to experience. Wonderland as they have never seen it before.
